description: Health topic lookup (MedlinePlus) — Plain-language consumer health information from MedlinePlus (US National Library of Medicine): search a condition, symptom or wellness topic and get the matching health topic pages with full summary, also-called names, body-system groups, MeSH terms and the MedlinePlus URL. Optional limit=1-10 (default 3), lang=es for Spanish. Public-domain NLM summaries with attribution; general information, not medical advice. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_topic
